A hackathon is where you transform your crazy ideas into real projects. Hundreds of students from across California form teams around an idea and collaboratively create technical solutions to problems we face in our local communities. # Travel Grant

Note: Travel funds for the Fall 2025 semester have been exhausted. We are currently accepting travel grant applications for the Spring 2026 semester.

The Virginia Tech Office of Undergraduate Research encourages students to present their research at conferences. OUR travel support program will cover expenses related to presenting at a conference. This rolling review process is designed to assist undergraduate students who have had their research or creative scholarship accepted for presentation at a regional, national or international conference. This program will provide travel funding to students who, without this support, may not be able to attend a conference to present their work. Current undergraduates from any discipline are eligible to apply for travel support.

The office will match funds you secure from other sources (such as your research mentor, department, college, student organization, student government, etc.) up to $750 for domestic travel and $1000 for international travel to support your travel, based on fund availability. Students must apply before they present at a conference. Please note that we are only able to fund one student per accepted presentation and students will only be eligible to receive travel support once per academic year. title: Introducing the Zeel Thakkar Memorial Scholarship – WordCamp Asia 2026
text:
Introducing the Zeel Thakkar Memorial Scholarship – WordCamp Asia 2026

# Introducing the Zeel Thakkar Memorial Scholarship

Zeel Thakkar joined WordCamp Asia 2026 as a stellar contributor and WordPress community builder.

Losing Zeel was a big setback to the entire organising team, and to honor her memory, we are launching the Zeel Thakkar Memorial Scholarship. This is a fully funded opportunity for women in India and Nepal to attend WordCamp Asia 2026 in Mumbai (April 9–11).

## What the Scholarship Covers

Each recipient will receive:

- Reimbursement support for travel and accommodation for the duration of the conference
- A free WordCamp Asia 2026 ticket
- Sponsors

No out-of-pocket costs. You just show up and participate.

## Who Should Apply

- WordCamp Asia is a great way to start your WordPress journey. It can be career-defining. If you’ve been curious but never had the opportunity, this scholarship is for you.
- We will prioritise folks who have not ever attended a flagship WordCamp (WordCamp Asia/ US/ EU) previously.
- This scholarship is open to women from India and Nepal who are passionate about WordPress, open source, or web development.
